verdict.rationale: Semgrep explicitly documents cross-file/cross-function taint analysis via 'cross-file analysis' (interfile) to detect vulnerabilities across files and folders, plus dataflow/taint rule support is core to Semgrep Code. However, this feature is gated behind Semgrep Code/Pro engine rather than pure open-source CLI, and community evidence shows real limitations in detection robustness (easily bypassed patterns, false negatives on simple aliasing), so real-world efficacy is caveated.
